name: RestockRadar – Stock & Waitlist Alerts
author: Michael Etokakpan

sections.description:
RestockRadar for WooCommerce is a lightweight plugin that enhances your store’s inventory management by providing automatic email notifications for stock changes.

Key Features

  • Admin Out-of-Stock Alerts: Automatically notifies store administrators when products go out of stock
  • Low Stock Warnings: Get notified when products fall below your specified threshold with sales velocity analysis
  • Customer Back-in-Stock Notifications: Allows customers to subscribe for notifications when out-of-stock products become available again
  • Customizable Messages: Fully customize all notification text, email subjects, and form messages
  • Rich Product Information: Detailed product data in notifications including sales history, categories, pricing, and stock analysis
  • Smart Duplicate Prevention: Prevents sending duplicate notifications with intelligent tracking
  • Clean Email Templates: Professional HTML email templates with product images and actionable insights
  • Secure Subscription Forms: AJAX-powered forms with nonce verification and rate limiting
  • Variable Product Support: Works with both simple and variable products

How It Works

  1. When a product’s stock falls below your threshold, admins receive a low stock warning with sales velocity analysis
  2. When a product goes completely out of stock, admins receive a detailed notification with full product information
  3. Customers see a customizable subscription form on out-of-stock product pages with pricing information
  4. When products are restocked, all subscribed customers receive notification emails automatically
  5. The plugin intelligently tracks notification status to prevent duplicate emails while allowing re-notifications for significant changes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the restockradar-stock-waitlist-alerts folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated
  4. The plugin will start working automatically – no configuration needed!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any configuration?

No, RestockRadar works out of the box with sensible defaults. However, you can extensively customize the plugin through WP Admin → RestockRadar → Settings, including notification text, thresholds, and email preferences.

Can I customize the notification messages?

Yes! Navigate to WP Admin → RestockRadar → Settings → Text Customization. You can customize:
* Email subject lines for all notification types
* Email headings and body text
* Customer form headings and descriptions
* Low stock warning messages

How do I set up low stock warnings?

Go to WP Admin → RestockRadar → Settings → Low Stock Notifications:
1. Enable “Low Stock Notifications”
2. Set your desired threshold (e.g., 5 units)
3. Customize the warning message if desired
The plugin will analyze sales velocity and estimate days until out of stock.

Can customers subscribe to variable product notifications?

Currently, the plugin supports notifications at the product level. Variation-level notifications are planned for a future release.

How are duplicate notifications prevented?

The plugin intelligently tracks notifications:
* Out of stock: Only sends once per stock-out event
* Low stock: Re-sends only if stock drops by more than 50% from last notification
* Automatically resets tracking when products are restocked above thresholds

What information is included in admin notifications?

Admin emails include comprehensive product data:
* Product image and description
* Current stock levels and thresholds
* Sales history (last 30 days)
* Daily average sales velocity
* Estimated days until out of stock
* Categories, tags, pricing, and SKU
* Direct links to edit or view the product

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin stores only email addresses and product preferences. Consider adding appropriate privacy policy disclosures about email collection and usage.

Can I have multiple admin email recipients?

Currently, notifications are sent to a single admin email address. You can configure this in Settings → Admin Notifications. Multiple recipients are planned for a future release.
